answers.why: Israel is the nation promised continued residence in its ancestral land if it obeys Moses' law.
Manasseh leads Judah and Jerusalem's inhabitants into wrongdoing.
Judah is the territory containing the fortified cities where military commanders are stationed.
Manasseh commands the people of Judah to serve the LORD.
The LORD is called Israel's God as Judah is commanded to worship him.
The seers speak in the name of the LORD, the God of the nation Israel.
Josiah purges Judah and Jerusalem of idolatrous shrines and images.
Judah is the kingdom Josiah cleanses alongside Jerusalem.
Ephraim names a tribal territory whose cities undergo Josiah's cleansing.
Simeon names a tribal territory whose cities undergo Josiah's cleansing.
Josiah's cleansing extends as far as the tribal territory of Naphtali.
The Levites collect temple contributions from the people of Manasseh.
The Levites collect temple contributions from the people of Ephraim.
The remnant of Israel contributes money for repairing the temple.
All Judah is included among the communities contributing temple funds.
Benjamin is included with Judah among the communities contributing temple funds.
Josiah seeks guidance for the survivors remaining in Israel.
Josiah seeks guidance for the survivors remaining in Judah.
Huldah introduces the national oracle as a message from the LORD God of Israel.
The LORD God of Israel addresses Judah's king concerning the nation's judgment.
The king gathers the elders of Judah together with those of Jerusalem.
All the men of Judah assemble to hear the covenant read.
Benjamin is the tribal territory whose residents are made to uphold the covenant.
Josiah makes everyone present in Israel serve the LORD their God.
